goal: Build a local-first evidence-grounded Promotion Studio capability branch with approval-bound publishing and reusable receipts without changing kernel authority.
acceptance_criteria: project evidence is projected into public-safe claims before any campaign drafting
promotion signals suppress duplicates and changes without public value
campaign, content, media, approval, publication, and analytics contracts are canonical and source-bound
external publication requires an exact-hash human approval and opaque local credentials
dry-run, restart-safe scheduling, fake publication, and at least two native adapters are qualified
one Self-Growth V1 campaign produces validated text, image, and video drafts with no public write
formal evaluation runs from one clean Source Closure and full repository regression passes

quality_metrics.method: Pillow image inspection and FFmpeg/ffprobe validation

quality_metrics.measure: approval, idempotency, retry, and restart safety
quality_metrics.method: injected transport and local atomic state

improvement: feed only aggregate analytics into future experience

interface_expectations: CapabilityRegistry remains the sole capability authority
Promotion Studio is an application capability branch, not a new runtime or planner
PublicationPlan and PublicationReceipt are restart-safe local authority
Postiz remains an optional separately deployed service boundary
production Registry, routing, Knowledge, validation, and delivery authorities remain unchanged

feedback: Promotion MVP satisfies evidence, claim, media, approval, scheduling, fake-publication, restart, and offline native-adapter gates.
Real test-account publication remains blocked because no credentials or explicit public-post approval were available.

worked: Deterministic claim-ledger and media generation reached zero unsupported claims and zero private leakage.
Injected HTTP transports qualified three native adapters without external writes.
Exact-hash approval plus atomic local state made duplicate and restart behavior deterministic.
did_not_work: The first evidence render exposed local absolute paths and was discarded before closure.
Evidence stored under experiments would have created a source-boundary freshness cycle, so durable evidence moved to project-management summaries.
experiments: 20 signal cases, 10 campaign cases, 6 media renders, fake publication lifecycle, and 3 native adapter contract probes all passed on one frozen source closure.
